column1: # better-maps search evaluation set: railway stations searched from another city (AP stations).
# Columns (tab separated): id, kind, query, expectation, as in queries.tsv.
# The query starts with the viewport and user position it is searched from ("berlin: ", "nuremberg: "), see
# run_stations.sh. kind: station -> the station (its biggest feature), counter -> other things that must not change.
# The expectation is a regex for the expected result ("name | address | type").
